verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֔ל שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְנִ֥י אֶחָ֛ד בָּֽחַר־ בּ֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נַ֣עַר וָרָ֑ךְ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְאָדָם֙ הַבִּירָ֔ה כִּ֖י לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ lə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nî ’e·ḥāḏ bā·ḥar- bōw ’ĕ·lō·hîm na·‘ar wā·rāḵ wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh kî lō lə·’ā·ḏām hab·bî·rāh kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then King David said to the whole assembly My son Solomon the one whom God has chosen is young and inexperienced The task is great because this palace is not for man but for the LORD God
verses.literalPt: O rei Davi disse a toda a congregação: Salomão, meu filho, o único a quem Deus escolheu, é ainda moço e tenro, e a obra é grande; porque o palácio não é para homem, mas para Deus Jeová.

verses.original: וּֽכְכָל־ כֹּחִ֞י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־ אֱלֹהַ֗י הַזָּהָ֣ב׀ לַ֠זָּהָב וְהַכֶּ֨סֶף לַכֶּ֜סֶף וְהַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת לַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת הַבַּרְזֶל֙ לַבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְהָעֵצִ֖ים לָעֵצִ֑ים אַבְנֵי־ שֹׁ֨הַם וּמִלּוּאִ֜ים אַבְנֵי־ פ֣וּךְ וְרִקְמָ֗ה וְכֹ֨ל אֶ֧בֶן יְקָרָ֛ה וְאַבְנֵי־ שַׁ֖יִשׁ לָרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḵāl- kō·ḥî hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî lə·ḇêṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hay haz·zā·hāḇ laz·zā·hāḇ wə·hak·ke·sep̄ lak·ke·sep̄ wə·han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ lan·nə·ḥō·šeṯ hab·bar·zel lab·bar·zel wə·hā·‘ê·ṣîm lā·‘ê·ṣîm ’aḇ·nê- šō·ham ū·mil·lū·’îm ’aḇ·nê- p̄ūḵ wə·riq·māh wə·ḵōl ’e·ḇen yə·qā·rāh wə·’aḇ·nê- ša·yiš lā·rōḇ
verses.literal: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God gold for the gold articles silver for the silver bronze for the bronze iron for the iron and wood for the wood as well as onyx . . . for the settings turquoise . . . stones of various colors all kinds of precious stones and slabs of marble all in abundance
verses.literalPt: Com todas as minhas forças preparei para a casa do meu Deus o ouro para as obras de ouro, a prata para as obras de prata, o bronze para as obras de bronze, o ferro para as obras de ferro e a madeira para as obras de madeira; pedras de ônix, pedras para obras de engaste, pedras para obras de marchetaria e de diversas cores e toda sorte de pedras preciosas e mármore em abundância.

verses.original: וְע֗וֹד בִּרְצוֹתִי֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֔י יֶשׁ־ לִ֥י סְגֻלָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב וָכָ֑סֶף נָתַ֤תִּי לְבֵית־ אֱלֹהַי֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה מִכָּל־ הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לְבֵ֥ית הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·wḏ bir·ṣō·w·ṯî bə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hay yeš- lî sə·ḡul·lāh zā·hāḇ wā·ḵā·sep̄ nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḇêṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hay lə·ma‘·lāh mik·kāl hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî lə·ḇêṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Moreover because of my delight in the house of my God . . . I now give for it . . . my personal treasures of gold and silver over and above all that I have provided for this holy temple
verses.literalPt: Além disso, porque pus o meu afeto na casa do meu Deus, dou a ela o ouro e a prata do tesouro que possuo, afora tudo o que preparei para a santa casa:

verses.original: שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מִזְּהַ֣ב אוֹפִ֑יר וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֲלָפִ֤ים כִּכַּר־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מְזֻקָּ֔ק לָט֖וּחַ קִיר֥וֹת הַבָּתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm kik·kə·rê zā·hāḇ miz·zə·haḇ ’ō·w·p̄îr wə·šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm kik·kar- ke·sep̄ mə·zuq·qāq lā·ṭū·aḥ qî·rō·wṯ hab·bāt·tîm
verses.literal: three thousand talents of gold the gold of Ophir and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay the walls of the buildings
verses.literalPt: três mil talentos de ouro, do ouro de Ofir, e sete mil talentos de prata refinada, para cobrir as paredes das casas;

verses.original: לַזָּהָ֤ב לַזָּהָב֙ וְלַכֶּ֣סֶף לַכֶּ֔סֶף וּלְכָל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּיַ֣ד חָרָשִׁ֑ים וּמִ֣י מִתְנַדֵּ֔ב לְמַלֹּ֥אות יָד֛וֹ הַיּ֖וֹם לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: laz·zā·hāḇ laz·zā·hāḇ wə·lak·ke·sep̄ lak·ke·sep̄ ū·lə·ḵāl- mə·lā·ḵāh bə·yaḏ ḥā·rā·šîm ū·mî miṯ·nad·dêḇ lə·mal·lō·wṯ yā·ḏōw hay·yō·wm Yah·weh
verses.literal: for the gold work and the silver work . . . and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen Now who is willing to consecrate himself to the LORD today
verses.literalPt: de ouro para as obras de ouro e de prata para as obras de prata e para toda sorte de obra que se devia fazer por mão de artífices. Quem se oferece voluntariamente a consagrar-se hoje a Jeová?

verses.original: וַיִּֽתְנַדְּבוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י׀ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְהַמֵּא֔וֹת וּלְשָׂרֵ֖י מְלֶ֥אכֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·nad·də·ḇū śā·rê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ wə·śā·rê šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl wə·śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ham·mê·’ō·wṯ ū·lə·śā·rê mə·le·ḵeṯ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then the leaders of the families the officers of the tribes of Israel the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly
verses.literalPt: Os príncipes das famílias, e os príncipes das tribos de Israel, e os capitães de mil e de cem, juntamente com os intendentes da obra do rei, fizeram ofertas voluntárias;

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֞וּ לַעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֣ים חֲמֵֽשֶׁת־ אֲלָפִים֮ וַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֣ים רִבּוֹ֒ וְכֶ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּנְחֹ֕שֶׁת רִבּ֛וֹ וּשְׁמוֹנַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים כִּכָּרִ֑ים וּבַרְזֶ֖ל מֵֽאָה־ אֶ֥לֶף כִּכָּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nū la·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm zā·hāḇ kik·kā·rîm ḥă·mê·šeṯ- ’ă·lā·p̄îm wa·’ă·ḏar·ḵō·nîm rib·bōw wə·ḵe·sep̄ kik·kā·rîm ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ rib·bōw ū·šə·mō·w·naṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm kik·kā·rîm ū·ḇar·zel mê·’āh- ’e·lep̄ kik·kā·rîm
verses.literal: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 . . . talents and 10,000 darics of gold 10,000 . . . talents of silver 18,000 . . . . . . talents of bronze and 100,000 . . . talents of iron
verses.literalPt: e deram para o serviço da Casa de Deus cinco mil talentos de ouro e dez mil daricos, dez mil talentos de prata, dezoito mil talentos de bronze e cem mil talentos de ferro.

verses.original: וְהַנִּמְצָ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ לְאוֹצַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה עַ֥ל יַד־ יְחִיאֵ֖ל הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nim·ṣā ’it·tōw ’ă·ḇā·nîm nā·ṯə·nū lə·’ō·w·ṣar bêṯ- Yah·weh ‘al yaḏ- yə·ḥî·’êl hag·gê·rə·šun·nî
verses.literal: Whoever had . . . precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite
verses.literalPt: Os que tinham pedras preciosas deram-nas para os tesouros da Casa de Jeová, que estavam ao cargo de Jeiel, gersonita.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֤וּ הָעָם֙ עַל־ הִֽתְנַדְּבָ֔ם כִּ֚י בְּלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם הִֽתְנַדְּב֖וּ לַיהוָ֑ה וְגַם֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂמַ֖ח שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·mə·ḥū hā·‘ām ‘al- hiṯ·nad·də·ḇām kî bə·lêḇ šā·lêm hiṯ·nad·də·ḇū Yah·weh wə·ḡam dā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ śā·maḥ śim·ḥāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: And the people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders for they had given to the LORD freely and wholeheartedly And King David also rejoiced . . . greatly
verses.literalPt: O povo se alegrou de fazer ofertas voluntárias, porque dum coração perfeito faziam ofertas voluntárias a Jeová; também o rei Davi se alegrou com grande alegria.

verses.original: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד בָּר֨וּךְ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֔ינוּ מֵעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·reḵ dā·wîḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh lə·‘ê·nê kāl- haq·qā·hāl way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ bā·rūḵ ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·ḇî·nū mê·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said May You be blessed O LORD God of our father Israel from everlasting to everlasting
verses.literalPt: Pelo que Davi bendisse a Jeová perante toda a congregação e disse: Sê bendito, ó Jeová, Deus de nosso pai Israel, para todo o sempre.

verses.original: לְךָ֣ יְ֠הוָה הַגְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְהַגְּבוּרָ֤ה וְהַתִּפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ וְהַנֵּ֣צַח וְהַה֔וֹד כִּי־ כֹ֖ל בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ לְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ הַמַּמְלָכָ֔ה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂ֖א לְכֹ֥ל׀ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵā Yah·weh hag·gə·ḏul·lāh wə·hag·gə·ḇū·rāh wə·hat·tip̄·’e·reṯ wə·han·nê·ṣaḥ wə·ha·hō·wḏ kî- ḵōl baš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇā·’ā·reṣ lə·ḵā Yah·weh ham·mam·lā·ḵāh wə·ham·miṯ·naś·śê lə·ḵōl lə·rōš
verses.literal: Yours O LORD is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You Yours O LORD is the kingdom and You are exalted as head over all
verses.literalPt: Tua é, ó Jeová, a grandeza, e o poder, e a glória, e a vitória, e a majestade, porque tudo o que há no céu e na terra é teu. Teu é, ó Jeová, o reino, e tu te exaltaste por chefe sobre todos.

verses.original: וְהָעֹ֤שֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד֙ מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מוֹשֵׁ֣ל בַּכֹּ֔ל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֑ה וּבְיָ֣דְךָ֔ לְגַדֵּ֥ל וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק לַכֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ō·šer wə·hak·kā·ḇō·wḏ mil·lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·’at·tāh mō·wō·šêl bak·kōl ū·ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā kō·aḥ ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh ū·ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā lə·ḡad·dêl ū·lə·ḥaz·zêq lak·kōl
verses.literal: Both riches and honor come from You and You are the ruler over all In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all
verses.literalPt: Tanto riquezas como honra vêm de ti, e tu dominas sobre tudo; na tua mão está força e poder; e na tua mão está o engrandecer e o dar forças a todos.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ מוֹדִ֥ים אֲנַ֖חְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וּֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְשֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū mō·w·ḏîm ’ă·naḥ·nū lāḵ ū·mə·hal·lîm lə·šêm tip̄·’ar·te·ḵā
verses.literal: Now therefore our God we give You thanks and we praise Your glorious name
verses.literalPt: Agora, nosso Deus, te rendemos graças e louvamos o teu glorioso nome.

verses.original: וְכִ֨י מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ וּמִ֣י עַמִּ֔י כִּֽי־ נַעְצֹ֣ר כֹּ֔חַ לְהִתְנַדֵּ֖ב כָּזֹ֑את כִּֽי־ מִמְּךָ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל וּמִיָּדְךָ֖ נָתַ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî mî ’ă·nî ū·mî ‘am·mî kî- na‘·ṣōr kō·aḥ lə·hiṯ·nad·dêḇ kā·zōṯ kî- mim·mə·ḵā hak·kōl ū·mî·yā·ḏə·ḵā nā·ṯan·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: But who am I and who are my people that we should be able . . . to give as generously as this For everything comes from You and from Your own hand we have given to You
verses.literalPt: Mas quem sou eu, e quem é o meu povo, para que assim pudéssemos fazer ofertas tão voluntariamente? Porque tudo vem de ti, e do que é teu to damos.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גֵרִ֨ים אֲנַ֧חְנוּ לְפָנֶ֛יךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִ֖ים כְּכָל־ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ כַּצֵּ֧ל׀ יָמֵ֛ינוּ עַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין מִקְוֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡê·rîm ’ă·naḥ·nū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·ṯō·wō·šā·ḇîm kə·ḵāl- ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū kaṣ·ṣêl yā·mê·nū ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ên miq·weh
verses.literal: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence as were all our forefathers Our days on earth are like a shadow without hope
verses.literalPt: Porque somos estrangeiros diante de ti e peregrinos, como o foram todos os nossos pais; os nossos dias sobre a terra são como a sombra, e não há permanência.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כֹ֣ל הֶהָמ֤וֹן הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲכִינֹ֔נוּ לִבְנֽוֹת־ לְךָ֥ בַ֖יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ מִיָּדְךָ֥ הִיא וּלְךָ֥ הַכֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ḵōl he·hā·mō·wn haz·zeh ’ă·šer hă·ḵî·nō·nū liḇ·nō·wṯ- lə·ḵā ḇa·yiṯ lə·šêm qāḏ·še·ḵā mî·yā·ḏə·ḵā hī ū·lə·ḵā hak·kōl
verses.literal: O LORD our God from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name and all of it belongs to You
verses.literalPt: Jeová, nosso Deus, toda esta riqueza que temos ajuntado para te edificarmos uma casa ao teu santo nome vem da tua mão, e a ti tudo pertence.

verses.original: וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּמֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּיֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִי֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כָל־ אֵ֔לֶּה וְעַתָּ֗ה עַמְּךָ֙ הַנִּמְצְאוּ־ פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהִֽתְנַדֶּב־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏa‘·tî ’ĕ·lō·hay kî ’at·tāh bō·ḥên lê·ḇāḇ ū·mê·šā·rîm tir·ṣeh ’ă·nî bə·yō·šer lə·ḇā·ḇî hiṯ·nad·daḇ·tî ḵāl ’êl·leh wə·‘at·tāh ‘am·mə·ḵā han·nim·ṣə·’ū- p̄ōh rā·’î·ṯî ḇə·śim·ḥāh lə·hiṯ·nad·deḇ- lāḵ
verses.literal: I know my God that You test the heart and delight in uprightness All these things I have given willingly and with an upright heart and now I have seen Your people who are present here giving joyfully and willingly to You
verses.literalPt: Eu sei, meu Deus, que tu provas o coração e que te agradas da sinceridade. Na sinceridade do meu coração, ofereci eu voluntariamente todas estas coisas; agora, vi com alegria que o teu povo que se acha aqui te faz ofertas voluntariamente.

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה אֱ֠לֹהֵי אַבְרָהָ֞ם יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ שֳׁמְרָה־ זֹּ֣את לְעוֹלָ֔ם לְיֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְהָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖ם אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām yiṣ·ḥāq wə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū šom·rāh- zōṯ lə·‘ō·w·lām lə·yê·ṣer maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ lə·ḇaḇ ‘am·me·ḵā wə·hā·ḵên lə·ḇā·ḇām ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: O LORD God of our fathers Abraham Isaac and Israel keep this desire forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people and direct their hearts toward You
verses.literalPt: Jeová, Deus de nossos pais, Abraão, Isaque e Israel, conserva para sempre no coração do teu povo estas disposições e estes pensamentos e estabelece o seu coração para contigo.

verses.original: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֗י תֵּ֚ן לֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם לִשְׁמוֹר֙ מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ עֵדְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְחֻקֶּ֑יךָ וְלַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַכֹּ֔ל וְלִבְנ֖וֹת הַבִּירָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֲכִינֽוֹתִי׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·liš·lō·mōh ḇə·nî tên lê·ḇāḇ šā·lêm liš·mō·wr miṣ·wō·ṯe·ḵā ‘ê·ḏə·wō·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḥuq·qe·ḵā wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hak·kōl wə·liḇ·nō·wṯ hab·bî·rāh ’ă·šer- hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî
verses.literal: And give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep and carry out all Your commandments decrees and statutes and to build Your palace for which I have made provision
verses.literalPt: Dá a meu filho Salomão um coração perfeito, para que guarde os teus mandamentos, os teus testemunhos e os teus estatutos, e cumpra todas estas coisas, e edifique o palácio, para o qual providenciei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ לְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֔ל בָּֽרְכוּ־ נָ֖א אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וַיְבָרֲכ֣וּ כָֽל־ הַקָּהָ֗ל לַיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹֽתֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְּד֧וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לַיהוָ֖ה וְלַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ lə·ḵāl haq·qā·hāl bā·rə·ḵū- nā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem way·ḇā·ră·ḵū ḵāl haq·qā·hāl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem way·yiq·qə·ḏū way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū Yah·weh wə·lam·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then David said to the whole assembly Bless . . . the LORD your God So the whole assembly blessed the LORD the God of their fathers They bowed down and paid homage to the LORD and to the king
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi a toda a congregação: Bendizei a Jeová, vosso Deus. Toda a congregação bendisse a Jeová, Deus de seus pais, inclinaram-se e prostraram-se perante Jeová e perante o rei.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה׀ זְ֠בָחִים וַיַּעֲל֨וּ עֹל֜וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְֽמָחֳרַת֮ הַיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֒ פָּרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף אֵילִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף כְּבָשִׂ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֑ם וּזְבָחִ֥ים לָרֹ֖ב לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·bə·ḥū Yah·weh zə·ḇā·ḥîm way·ya·‘ă·lū ‘ō·lō·wṯ Yah·weh lə·mā·ḥo·raṯ hay·yō·wm ha·hū pā·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’ê·lîm ’e·lep̄ kə·ḇā·śîm ’e·lep̄ wə·nis·kê·hem ū·zə·ḇā·ḥîm lā·rōḇ lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The next day . . . . . . they offered sacrifices . . . and presented burnt offerings to the LORD a thousand bulls a thousand rams and a thousand lambs along with their drink offerings and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel
verses.literalPt: Ao outro dia, imolaram sacrifícios a Jeová e ofereceram-lhe holocaustos de mil novilhos, mil carneiros e mil cordeiros com as suas libações e sacrifícios em abundância a favor de todo o Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֨וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֜וּ לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בְּשִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֤יכוּ שֵׁנִית֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּמְשְׁח֧וּ לַיהוָ֛ה לְנָגִ֥יד וּלְצָד֖וֹק לְכֹהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiš·tū lip̄·nê Yah·weh bay·yō·wm ha·hū bə·śim·ḥāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh way·yam·lî·ḵū šê·nîṯ liš·lō·mōh ḇen- dā·wîḏ way·yim·šə·ḥū Yah·weh lə·nā·ḡîḏ ū·lə·ṣā·ḏō·wq lə·ḵō·hên
verses.literal: That day they ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD Then, for a second time, they designated David’s son Solomon as king anointing him before the LORD as ruler and Zadok as the priest
verses.literalPt: Comeram e beberam, naquele dia, perante Jeová, com grande alegria. Pela segunda vez, proclamaram rei a Salomão, filho de Davi, e ungiram-no a Jeová para ser príncipe, e a Zadoque, para ser sacerdote.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב שְׁ֠לֹמֹה עַל־ כִּסֵּ֨א יְהוָ֧ה׀ לְמֶ֛לֶךְ תַּֽחַת־ דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖יו וַיַּצְלַ֑ח וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šeḇ šə·lō·mōh ‘al- kis·sê Yah·weh lə·me·leḵ ta·ḥaṯ- dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇîw way·yaṣ·laḥ way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lāw kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of his father David He prospered and all Israel obeyed him . . .
verses.literalPt: Salomão assentou-se no trono de Jeová como rei em lugar de seu pai Davi, e foi próspero; e todo o Israel lhe rendeu obediência.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַגִּבֹּרִ֔ים וְגַ֕ם כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑יד נָ֣תְנוּ יָ֔ד תַּ֖חַת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl haś·śā·rîm wə·hag·gib·bō·rîm wə·ḡam kāl- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ nā·ṯə·nū yāḏ ta·ḥaṯ šə·lō·mōh ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: All the officials and mighty men as well as all of King David’s sons pledged their allegiance to King Solomon
verses.literalPt: Todos os príncipes, os homens poderosos e, do mesmo modo, todos os filhos de Davi se submeteram ao rei Salomão.

verses.original: וַיְגַדֵּ֨ל יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֔וּת אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ הָיָ֧ה עַל־ כָּל־ מֶ֛לֶךְ לְפָנָ֖יו עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḡad·dêl Yah·weh ’eṯ- šə·lō·mōh lə·ma‘·lāh lə·‘ê·nê kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·yit·tên ‘ā·lāw hō·wḏ mal·ḵūṯ ’ă·šer lō- hā·yāh ‘al- kāl- me·leḵ lə·p̄ā·nāw ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The LORD highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal majesty such as had not been bestowed on any king in Israel before him
verses.literalPt: Jeová engrandeceu muito a Salomão à vista de todo o Israel e deu-lhe tal majestade real, qual antes dele não teve nenhum rei em Israel.

verses.original: וְדָוִיד֙ בֶּן־ יִשָׁ֔י מָלַ֖ךְ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wîḏ ben- yi·šāy mā·laḵ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, Davi, filho de Jessé, reinou sobre todo o Israel.

verses.original: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלַךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּחֶבְר֤וֹן מָלַךְ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם מָלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer mā·laḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn mā·laḵ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim mā·laḵ šə·lō·šîm wə·šā·lō·wōš
verses.literal: The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years seven years in Hebron . . . and thirty-three years . . . in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: O tempo que reinou sobre todo o Israel foi quarenta anos; em Hebrom, reinou sete anos, e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙מָת֙ בְּשֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֔ה שְׂבַ֥ע יָמִ֖ים עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָב֑וֹד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ bə·śê·ḇāh ṭō·w·ḇāh śə·ḇa‘ yā·mîm ‘ō·šer wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ way·yim·lōḵ šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: He died at a ripe old age full of years riches and honor and his son Solomon reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Morreu numa boa velhice, cheio de dias, de bens e de honra. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Salomão.

verses.original: וְדִבְרֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאֲחרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל הָרֹאֶ֔ה וְעַל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא וְעַל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י גָּ֥ד הַחֹזֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏiḇ·rê dā·wîḏ ham·me·leḵ hā·ri·šō·nîm wə·hā·’ă·ḥ·rō·nîm hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- diḇ·rê šə·mū·’êl hā·rō·’eh wə·‘al- diḇ·rê nā·ṯān han·nā·ḇî wə·‘al- diḇ·rê gāḏ ha·ḥō·zeh
verses.literal: Now the acts of King David from first to last are indeed written in the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer . . . the Chronicles of Nathan the Prophet and the Chronicles of Gad the Seer
verses.literalPt: Os atos do rei Davi, os primeiros como os últimos, eis que estão escritos na história do vidente Samuel, na história do profeta Natã e na história do vidente Gade,

verses.original: עִ֥ם כָּל־ מַלְכוּת֖וֹ וּגְבוּרָת֑וֹ וְהָעִתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ עָלָיו֙ וְעַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘im kāl- mal·ḵū·ṯōw ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw wə·hā·‘it·tîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇə·rū ‘ā·lāw wə·‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘al kāl- mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: together with all the details of his reign his might and the circumstances that came upon him and Israel and all the kingdoms of the lands
verses.literalPt: juntamente com todo o seu reinado, e seu poder, e os tempos que passaram sobre ele, sobre Israel e sobre todos os reinos dos países.
